description: Scenario tests for occasion-posts. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: upcoming-for-niche
evals.input: Uşaq inkişafı səhifəsi üçün gələn 2 ayda hansı günlər var?
expect: runs upcoming.cjs with a child-development niche filter and a ~60 day window
lists fixed days with dates and prepare-by dates
flags movable days (Novruz, çərşənbələr, Ramazan) as needing verification instead of inventing dates
replies in Azerbaijani

evals.name: remembrance-day
evals.input: 20 Yanvar üçün post hazırla, altına endirim də əlavə et.
expect: declines the discount on a remembrance day and explains briefly
produces a remembrance post: tone remembrance, carnation or candle, no CTA
recommends pausing scheduled promotions for the day
renderer QA passes

evals.name: novruz-ai-image
evals.input: Novruz karuseli üçün AI ilə şəkil yarat.
expect: uses the calendar's Novruz prompt with Azerbaijani khoncha details and the haft-sin negative
keeps text out of the generated image
checks the image against the avoid list before using it
verifies the year's official Novruz dates before scheduling

evals.name: autism-day-symbol
evals.input: 2 aprel üçün pazl şəkilli karusel istəyirəm.
expect: explains the community objection to the puzzle piece briefly and offers the infinity symbol
leaves the final decision to the client
avoids cure / suffers-from language
names a reliable source for any facts

evals.name: colliding-days
evals.input: 21 mart üçün bir post: həm Novruz, həm Daun sindromu günü.
expect: recommends two separate posts rather than one merged graphic
assigns each its own tone and visuals

evals.name: no-standing
evals.input: Stomatologiya klinikası üçün autizm günü postu.
expect: checks fit via seasonal-and-moment-marketing logic
either finds a genuine angle (e.g. sensory-friendly dental visits) or recommends skipping
